{{Quote|Jedi for Jedi!|Kyp Durron|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>}}
The '''radical party'''<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> was a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|apprentices]] that rallied around [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. They advocated a more aggressive stand against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] which did not take [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] concerns into account. Although never expelled from the [[New Jedi Order]], they came into conflict with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] leadership, which most of the other masters rallied around.

While the radicals argued that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was with them, the numbers were against them. During the war, Durron's aggressive stance saw him become increasingly isolated from the rest of the Jedi Order. Additionally, many prominent followers of Durron were either killed or came to believe that Durron himself was unstable. Eventually, the radicals were somewhat co-opted when Luke Skywalker placed Durron on the [[High Council (Galactic Alliance)|High Council]] when [[Cal Omas]] became [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]].
